mentions.name: Nekode
mentions.description: A macOS menubar app that displays desktop cats mirroring the state of AI coding agent sessions (OpenCode, Claude Code, Copilot CLI, VSCode Copilot): cats sleep when idle, walk when working, sit when waiting for input, and run toward the cursor when permission is needed. Fully native Swift with no Electron, under 5 MB, zero network requests, and all session data stays local as plain JSON. Originally source-available under an honor-system license, it is being fully open sourced with the license removed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve built Nekode (https://github.com/Jakob-98/nekode), which is desktop-cats for monitoring your AI coding agent sessions (OpenCode/Claude Code/ Copilot CLI/VSCode Copilot). It works as a macOS menubar app, and the cats run around on your desktop.
